method.what: The Meyer rule (the owner, 2026-10-14) where an entry has "fractions", else rule D: the TU Berlin database's pp / ff (single notes as softly / loudly as possible) are the player's ppp / fff. Meyer: written pp / ff at fractions a / b of each pitch's span above its pp, a = (P_pp - X_lo) / (X_hi - X_lo), b = (P_ff - X_lo) / (X_hi - X_lo), X single-note extremes, P rapid two-octave scales (J. Meyer, Acoustics and the Performance of Music, Springer 2009, chapter 3; each entry's "meyer" has the section and figures), p .. f in 5 equal dB steps pp -> ff, ppp -> pp and ff -> fff one step each. Rule D (the owner, 2026-10-12): 7 equal steps of span / 7 (a = 1/7, b = 6/7). Both relative to mp; span = ff - pp of one player's sound power, smoothed; long = SSO's All techniques Long, rmsDb less CC1 64's. marksMid: the player's dB from mp at midPitch, both rules; realDbMid: less long at the marking's CC1 (16 .. 127): MuseScore's CC11 before the headroom
